questions.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways.” You can make statements, give reasons, or cite examples to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
questions.correctAnswer:
With the application of information technology in education, college students can now learn in more diverse and efficient ways. Digital resources extend learning beyond the classroom and allow students to choose approaches that match their needs.

For example, recorded lectures let learners revisit a difficult explanation at their own pace. Online libraries make it easier to compare sources, while discussion platforms enable students to exchange questions with classmates. These tools can save time and provide timely support when they are used with clear goals. In my experience, reviewing a short instructional video before a laboratory class helped me understand the procedure and concentrate on the experiment. However, convenience does not remove the need for active thinking. Switching constantly between applications or copying answers without reflection may reduce the quality of learning.

Students should therefore plan their study sessions, select reliable resources and check understanding through practice. Universities can provide guidance on effective and responsible use of technology. When digital tools serve a thoughtful learning process, they make education more flexible while helping students develop lasting knowledge and independent study habits.

And it involves negative as well as positive consequences.

It's natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain. In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment. But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur. This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation. It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable.

This internal pressure to succeed at all costs demands a lot of effort. It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment.

Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life. Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure. They end up dissatisfied both at work and outside of it.

An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation.

However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.
